summary_en: Ferrotec Corporation announced a tender offer for all outstanding shares of Nippon Resistor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard Market) at 1,901 yen per share, with a minimum purchase of 618,700 shares (50.01% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock). The offer period runs from September 18 to November 5, 2026. The target company's board supports the offer, and two major shareholders have agreed to tender their 146,663 shares (11.85% of outstanding shares).
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Nippon Resistor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 6977)
translation_en_brief:
Ferrotec Corporation announced on September 17, 2026, that its board of directors has decided to launch a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Nippon Resistor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard Market, code 6977), excluding treasury stock held by the target company itself. The offer price is set at 1,901 yen per share. The tender offer period runs for 30 business days from September 18 to November 5, 2026.

Ferrotec has set a minimum purchase threshold of 618,700 shares, which represents 50.01% of shares outstanding (calculated as 1,230,700 shares, excluding treasury stock and fractional shares). The company has set no maximum limit, intending to acquire all outstanding shares to make Nippon Resistor a wholly owned subsidiary. The minimum threshold of approximately 50% ensures that Ferrotec achieves majority control, allowing it to complete the acquisition through subsequent procedures if needed. Two significant shareholders of the target company—Junshi Kimura (CEO, 106,500 shares, 8.61%) and Yoshinori Imai (outside director, 40,163 shares, 3.25%)—have already committed to tendering their combined 146,663 shares (11.85% of shares outstanding) through share purchase agreements. The target company's board of directors has expressed support and recommends shareholders to tender their shares.
